connector.name: Talos Linux MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Talos Linux - resources, services, logs, health, config, lifecycle via gRPC.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package talos-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nosmoht account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TALOS_CONTEXT
env.description: Context name override (default: active context from config)

env.name: TALOS_MCP_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to "true" to disable all mutating tools (default: false)

env.name: TALOS_MCP_HTTP_ADDR
env.description: If set (e.g. ":8080"), serve Streamable HTTP instead of stdio

env.name: TALOS_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Required bearer token when HTTP mode is active (TALOS_MCP_HTTP_ADDR is set)

env.name: TALOS_MCP_ALLOWED_NODES
env.description: Comma-separated IPs, hostnames, and CIDR ranges permitted as tool targets. Unset or empty allows all nodes.

env.name: TALOS_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS
env.description: Comma-separated path prefixes permitted for talos_read_file and talos_list_files (e.g. /etc,/proc). Unset or empty allows all paths.

env.name: TALOS_MCP_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK
env.description: Set to "true" to bypass upgrade path validation (default: false)

env.name: TALOS_MCP_RATE_LIMIT
env.description: HTTP mode: token-bucket refill rate in requests/second (float, default: 10)

env.name: TALOS_MCP_RATE_BURST
env.description: HTTP mode: token-bucket burst capacity (int, default: 20)

env.name: TALOS_MCP_MAX_BODY_SIZE
env.description: HTTP mode: max POST request body size in bytes (int, default: 4194304 = 4 MiB)

env.name: TALOS_MCP_MAX_CONCURRENT
env.description: HTTP mode: max concurrent POST handlers; returns 503 on overload (int, default: 20)
